title: Double shortcuts of standard hypercube decompositions
summary: In this paper, we study the double shortcuts associated with pairs of standard hypercube decompositions of arbitrary Bruhat intervals in the symmetric group. Our results imply that a conjecture stated in [Bull. London Math. Soc., 57 (2025), no. 8] holds for the class of standard hypercube decompositions. If this conjecture were to hold for all hypercube decompositions, then the Combinatorial Invariance Conjecture for Kazhdan--Lusztig polynomials would follow.
